facts.fact: Monitor reports that phase one of the National Backbone Infrastructure completed in June 2008 laid 168km of fibre linking Kampala to Mukono, Bombo and Jinja, with later phases adding 1,400km, 756km to western Uganda and the Tanzania and Rwanda borders, and an RCIP phase extending to West Nile.

facts.fact: Monitor says NITA-U is the statutory body mandated to coordinate government IT services, and that its central data centre at Statistics House manages e-government services, which agencies such as UCC and NIRA found unreliable.
